deploy-bot: Deploy started -> fanout to staging. Deploy ID D-20260320-87. Services: runtime@v2.14.1 (tag: runtime-release-2026-03-20, sha: def9b2a), api@v1.9.0 (sha: a1c3f7e), console@v0.8.3 (sha: 5b7d11c). Rollout policy: parallel with runtime canary 10%. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/D-20260320-87
emma: Noted — I'll monitor p95/p99 and error budget. Set canary heatcheck to 5m.
raj: runtime canary started on 2 nodes. KV cache warming. Logs:
```
[runtime][init] kvcache warmup 1/2
[runtime][sched] kernel selection: fallback-path
```
deploy-bot: runtime canary (10%) applied. Health checks: 3/3 ok.
lina: api canary rolled out to 3 pods, 0 errors so far. Hitting runtime canary for upstream calls.
jesse: console canary deployed to 2 instances. Saw an initial handful of 500s but recovered in 30s.
emma: Alert -> runtime canary p95 +30% at t+4m. Investigating. @raj please check GPU mem / kernel fallback.
raj: digging in. I'm seeing elevated GPU memory for runtime@runtime-release-2026-03-20. Looks like a quantization kernel fallback causing extra allocations. Rolling back canary to previous runtime sha to stop bleeding.
deploy-bot: Action logged: rollback runtime canary. Pinning runtime to runtime@v2.13.9 (sha: abc1234) on canary nodes. Rollback initiated.
maya: Noted for release notes: runtime pinned due to kernel fallback -> memory spike. Holding full rollout until root cause identified.
lina: Pausing api full rollout until runtime is stable.
jesse: :thumbsup: Good call.
deploy-bot: Deploy summary: runtime canary rolled back to v2.13.9; api/console rollouts paused. Incident ticket created: INC-20260320-9. Links -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20260320-9
emma: I'll keep monitors at high sensitivity and own the postmortem coordination. Assigning to @raj and @ml-infra for root cause + repro.
raj: On it — will repro quant/kernel path locally and open a follow-up PR if needed.
